items.q: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?

privacy.metaDescription: How Ventura Auto collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Ventura Auto respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you use our website or rent a vehicle, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you browse our website or make a rental booking, we may collect your name, phone number, email address, home address, driver's licence details, payment information, and rental history. We also collect basic technical data such as your browser type, device, and the pages you visit.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to process bookings, verify your identity and driving eligibility, manage payments and deposits, provide customer support, send booking confirmations and service updates, and improve our website and services.

sections.heading: Legal Basis for Processing
sections.body: We process your personal data to perform our rental agreement with you, to comply with legal obligations such as tax and insurance reporting, and to pursue our legitimate interests in operating and improving our business.

sections.heading: Sharing Your Information
sections.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with service providers who help us operate, such as payment processors and insurance partners, and with government authorities when required by Indonesian law.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorised access, loss, or misuse. Payments are processed through certified payment providers using industry-standard encryption.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We keep your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy or as required by applicable law, after which it is securely deleted or anonymised.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, and you may object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below. You may also lodge a complaint with the Indonesian data protection authority.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences, understand how you use the site, and improve your experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the 'last updated' date at the top of this page. Significant changes will be announced on our website.

privacy.contactIntro: If you have questions about this policy or your personal data, reach us at:

terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions for renting a vehicle from Ventura Auto.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the Ventura Auto website and the rental of our vehicles. By renting a vehicle or using our services, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: About Our Service
sections.body: Ventura Auto is a premium car rental provider operating in Indonesia. We rent vehicles for personal and business use, subject to availability and the terms below.

sections.heading: Rental Requirements
sections.body: To rent a vehicle, you must be at least 21 years old and hold a driver's licence that has been valid for at least one year. A valid government-issued ID and a refundable security deposit are required at pick-up.

sections.heading: Bookings and Payment
sections.body: Bookings are confirmed once payment is received. We accept payment by credit card, debit card, and bank transfer. Rental rates cover the agreed rental period and standard mileage; additional charges may apply for extras, fuel, or additional drivers.

sections.heading: Deposits
sections.body: A security deposit is held at the start of your rental and released after the vehicle is returned in good condition. We may deduct from the deposit for damage, late return, traffic fines, or unpaid charges.

sections.heading: Cancellation Policy
sections.body: You may cancel a booking up to 24 hours before pick-up for a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours of pick-up are subject to a charge of one day's rental rate. No-shows are not refunded.

sections.heading: Driver Responsibilities
sections.body: You must drive responsibly and comply with all traffic laws. The vehicle may only be driven by drivers listed on the rental agreement. You are responsible for the vehicle while it is in your care, including any damage, loss, or theft.

sections.heading: Prohibited Uses
sections.body: You may not use the vehicle for illegal activities, racing, off-road driving, carrying hazardous materials, or subleasing. Smoking and carrying pets are not permitted unless agreed in advance.

sections.heading: Insurance
sections.body: Our rental rates include basic insurance. Depending on your package, you may purchase additional coverage for reduced excess. Insurance does not cover damage caused by driver negligence or breach of these terms.

sections.heading: Breakdowns and Accidents
sections.body: If the vehicle breaks down or is involved in an accident, stop driving, make sure everyone is safe, and contact our 24/7 support line immediately. Do not make any admission of liability or settle claims without our approval.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Ventura Auto is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from your rental, including loss of profits or business opportunities. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Any disputes shall be resolved by the competent courts of Indonesia.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may revise these terms from time to time. Revised terms apply to bookings made after the change takes effect.

story.metaDescription: How Ventura Auto grew from a single sedan in Denpasar in 2015 to a premium fleet across 12 Indonesian cities.
story.title: Our Story
story.intro: Ventura Auto began in 2015 with one sedan in Denpasar and a simple belief: a car rental should feel premium from the first click to the final drop-off.
paragraphs: It started with a single rented sedan and a handshake promise: clean cars, honest pricing, and drivers who treat every trip as if it were their own. Our founder spent his evenings at the car wash and his mornings behind the wheel, learning every route in Denpasar before the sun was fully up.

Word travelled. A business trip became a company account, a wedding became a fleet. Today Ventura Auto operates across 12 cities in Indonesia, from Denpasar to Bandung, Surabaya, and Jakarta, with a hand-picked fleet that ranges from executive sedans to full supercars.

What has not changed is the standard. Every unit still passes a 120-point inspection before each rental, every chauffeur still trains through the same academy, and every booking still comes with 24/7 support. We grow by the number of passengers who ride with us again.
